question: Avoprokenya brand company behind avocado oil
markdown:
The company behind the brand is
Avopro EPZ Limited
, located in Sagana, Central Kenya. They specialize in extracting and marketing cold-pressed extra virgin and crude avocado oil for the food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries, working with a network of thousands of smallholder farmers
